# Contributing

Maintainer: [@cptntrps](https://github.com/cptntrps).

Use [issues](https://github.com/cptntrps/korean-word-of-the-day/issues) for
non-sensitive bug reports, suggestions, and questions. Describe what you observed
and what you expected; for display issues, include your browser and screen size.
Remove personal information from screenshots before sharing them.

For pull requests, explain the change and any checks you performed. Keep changes
focused and preserve the project's static, dependency-free setup. The existing
test command is documented in the [README](../README.md#test).

The six numbered files in `docs/` are generated. Follow the instructions in the
[documentation index](../docs/README.md) before proposing documentation changes.

Do not commit credentials, real environment files, or local dependency folders.
Use the [security reporting instructions](SECURITY.md) for sensitive reports.
